comparison.objective: Move a live-wire surrogate off a walkway using an insulated stick.
comparison.physical_skill: Indirect manipulation of an articulated cable with a rigid tool while maintaining electrical-clearance constraints.
comparison.success_condition: No robot link touches the cable; the cable clears the walkway, its plug enters the parking zone, and it remains on the table.
comparison.reason: Indirect cable pushing and hazard avoidance share only generic tool use with the candidate and lack fastening, tuning, or damping tests.
